interpolation_notes: Tokens: {phrase} (the flagged trigger phrase, verbatim from lexicon match), {rate} (hourly rate from storage, or fallback string), {hours} (placeholder for user-entered estimate), {date} (placeholder for revised delivery date), {client} (client name placeholder), {sender} (freelancer name placeholder). Replacement is literal — no escaping needed inside templates. Unknown tokens are left as-is so the user sees what's missing.

templates.label: Neutral
templates.description: Respectful + businesslike. Safe default for most clients.
templates.subject: Quick note on scope — change order
templates.body:
Hi {client},

Thanks for flagging this — happy to include it. To keep the project on track and the original timeline intact, I'll send over a quick change order:

> "{phrase}"

Estimate: {hours} at {rate}, with a revised delivery date of {date}. Once you confirm, I'll get started on it.

Best,
{sender}

templates.label: Friendly
templates.description: Warmer opener, same firmness on the ask. Good for established or casual client relationships.
templates.subject: Loving the direction — quick scope note
templates.body:
Hey {client},

Great call on this one — totally see why it'd improve things. To make sure we keep everything moving smoothly without surprises on the timeline, I'll send a short change order for the addition:

> "{phrase}"

Looking at roughly {hours} on this, billed at {rate}. New delivery: {date}. Reply with a 👍 and I'll roll it in.

Cheers,
{sender}

templates.label: Concise
templates.description: Minimal text, no preamble. For fast-paced clients who prefer telegraphic exchanges.
templates.subject: Change order — new ask
templates.body:
Hi {client},

New scope:
> "{phrase}"

{hours} at {rate}. Revised delivery: {date}.

Confirm to proceed.

{sender}

templates.label: Formal
templates.description: Full change-order documentation. For clients in regulated industries or anyone who needs the paper trail.
templates.subject: Change order request — {date}
templates.body:
Hi {client},

This message documents a change request that extends the agreed Statement of Work.

REQUEST CONTEXT:
The following ask was raised, which falls outside the current scope:

> "{phrase}"

PROPOSED CHANGE ORDER:
  • Scope addition: as quoted above
  • Estimated effort: {hours}
  • Rate: {rate}
  • Revised delivery date: {date}
  • All other SOW terms remain unchanged

Please reply with explicit confirmation ("approved" or equivalent) to authorize this change order. Without confirmation, the original SOW scope and timeline remain in effect.

Best regards,
{sender}
